title: Lucas Beyn DESTROYS Piers Morgan Panel On Live TV
description:
In this video we react to one of the most intense and unfiltered debates to ever air on Piers Morgan Uncensored. Lucas Beyn, also known as The Amazing Lucas, went head to head with Piers Morgan, Jillian Michaels, and Riley Gaines in a debate that covered free speech, political hypocrisy, dark humor, and the double standards surrounding how different communities are treated when tragedy strikes.

The segment begins with Piers Morgan confronting Lucas about a series of social media posts he made following the passing of Charlie Kirk. Piers presents the posts on screen and challenges Lucas to explain why he made them and whether he finds the situation funny. What follows is a debate that goes far deeper than most people expected.

Lucas responds by listing specific examples of memes and posts that were made by people on the right targeting George Floyd, Breonna Taylor, Trayvon Martin, and Tamir Rice. He argues that those posts were defended under the banner of free speech and dark humor for years without any meaningful backlash from the same people now expressing outrage. His central argument is that the reaction to his posts exposes a deeper hypocrisy in how free speech is selectively defended depending on who the target is.

Piers pushes back hard, asking Lucas directly whether he is happy about what happened to Charlie Kirk. Lucas denies that and instead references a well known quote about how some people cause happiness wherever they go and others whenever they go. The excha
